name: callsign
description: A personal AI agent screens incoming conversations before they reach a doctor.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:ssl: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:ssl -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
